heading: Secrets
subtitle: Store passwords and keys on this device.

firstRun.title: Keep credentials out of your workflows
firstRun.body1: Secrets live in an encrypted vault on this Mac. A workflow step references a secret by name, and Mill fills in the value when the step runs.
firstRun.body2: Guardrails decide which steps may read each secret, and every read lands in the access history.
